FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
ImF)hal, the 14l1 July, 2026
HCMEST-12011/1/2026-ESTT-IISECTION-HCM/ I Sq :B : it is hereby notified to all
concerned that the online registration and submission of application forms for direct
recruitment to the posts of Manipur Judicial Service Grade - III, advertised vide
Advertisement of even number dated 04.07.2026, shall remain open indefinitely and beyond
14.07.2026 (04:00 P.M.), the closing date notified in the said advertisement. This decision has
been taken in view of the order(s) passed in W.P. (C) No. 1110/2025, pending before the
Hon1)Ie Supreme Court of India. The revised closing date for online registration and
submission of application forms shall be notified separately.
It is further notified that Guwahati has been added as an additional Examination
Centre along with Imphal. Candidates who have already submitted, or who are yet to submit
their application forms and wish to opt for Guwahati as their Examination Centre shall be
provided with a separate link on the official website (www.hcmimphal.nic.in) to exercise such
option after closure of the online registration and submission of application forms. A separate
notification in this regard shall be issued in due course.
Note: Candidates are advised to remain vigilant and refer only to the official website of the
for all updates and further necessary notifications.
(OJESH MUTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
